parsed.reply: In Spanish, verbs like «picar» (when meaning to itch) take an indirect object pronoun («me», «te», «le») to show who experiences the sensation. The thing causing the itch acts as the grammatical subject («la nariz», «la salsa»), so you say «la nariz me pica» (literally "the nose itches to me"), not «yo pico» ("I itch" in the sense of causing an itch or stinging others).
